accepted.quote: They do not represent serious attempts at permitting reform--paying someone $10 million to receive a guaranteed permit with limited ability for anyone to challenge it is not permitting reform.
accepted.rationale: The passage criticizes provisions that guarantee pipeline permits with limited challenge as not real reform, supporting strong environmental review.

accepted.quote: Subtitle B is a radical proposal that would gut critical environmental protections and programs, harming the health and welfare of all Americans.
accepted.rationale: The passage opposes repealing EPA programs and frames it as harming protections, indicating support for environmental regulation.
